results.name: shader_get_vertex_shader_permutation
results.evidence: Existing name matches the code: switches on a shader-type field (+0x24) minus 1, returning permutation indices built from per-type sub-fields (+0x5c, +0x2a) with special-casing when a flag (+0x29 bit3) or (byte 0 bit2) is set, consistent with selecting a vertex shader permutation per shader type.
results.summary: Selects the vertex shader permutation index for a shader tag instance (in_ECX) based on its shader type and per-type flags/fields.

results.name: shader_get_two_sided_flag
results.evidence: Switches on the same shader-type field (+0x24) as the neighboring functions and returns bit 1 of a per-type flags byte (+0x29 for types 5-7, +0x28 for type 9); plausible per-type boolean shader property accessor, exact semantics unconfirmed.
results.summary: Returns a per-shader-type boolean flag bit from a shader tag instance, likely a rendering property such as two-sidedness.

results.name: shader_get_alpha_tested_flag
results.evidence: Same dispatch pattern as FUN_0053fde0 but only for shader types 5-7 and reading bit 4 of the flags byte at +0x29, a distinct per-type boolean property.
results.summary: Returns another per-shader-type boolean flag bit (distinct from FUN_0053fde0) from a shader tag instance, likely a rendering property such as alpha testing.

results.name: shader_texture_animation_evaluate
results.evidence: Existing name matches the code: calls periodic_function_evaluate three times with per-axis periods/offsets (+4,+0xc,+0x14 fields of an animation struct), computes a rotation angle and builds two output 4-float rows via cos/sin, the standard construction of a 2D affine UV animation transform.
results.summary: Evaluates a texture UV animation (scroll u/v and rotation) at the given time, producing two transform rows (in unaff_EBX/unaff_EDI) used to animate texture coordinates.

results.name: shader_periodic_animation_evaluate_pair
results.evidence: Calls periodic_function_evaluate twice against two independent period/amplitude pairs stored in an animation struct (unaff_ESI+0x154/0x158 and +0x160/0x164), writing the two results to param_1/param_2, analogous in shape to shader_texture_animation_evaluate's per-axis periodic calls.
results.summary: Evaluates two independent periodic animation channels (e.g. animated shader properties) at the given time and writes their scaled results to the two output floats.

results.name: game_timer_get_digit_pair
results.evidence: Switches on in_AX (0-9) dividing the global millisecond counter DAT_00721e50 by 10/100/1000/10000/60000/600000/3600000/36000000 and returning quotient/remainder pairs, matching digit extraction for a MM:SS/HH:MM:SS style clock display (case 5 divides by 6, the max value for a tens-of-seconds digit).
results.summary: Extracts a pair of display digits (tens/ones) for a given position of a millisecond-based game timer, for rendering a clock/stopwatch HUD.

results.name: game_timer_update
results.evidence: Converts a frame/tick counter (DAT_006f1d6c+0xc) to milliseconds via *1000/30 (matching Halo's 30Hz tick rate), and if a running flag (DAT_00721e54) is set, decrements the timer DAT_00721e50 by the elapsed delta, clamping at 0, then stores the new baseline in DAT_00721e58.
results.summary: Advances/counts down the global millisecond game timer (DAT_00721e50) based on elapsed ticks since the last update, when the timer is running.
